تقتصري (form VIII)
# تَقْتَصِرِي (taqtaṣirī) /taq.ta.sˤi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
# تُقْتَصَرِي (tuqtaṣarī) /tuq.ta.sˤa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِقْتَصَرَ (iqtaṣara)
